propositions: Two regex-based code paths and one scope extractor currently key on '## Success Criteria' heading, making it load-bearing for store migration verification
Repoint the heading-detection regex from '^##\s+Success Criteria' to '^##\s+Acceptance Criteria' in both _clarity_score copies to collapse the two headings into one
Update all test fixtures that embed '## Success Criteria' in ticket descriptions to use '## Acceptance Criteria' instead, converting bullets to '- [ ]' items where AC is the only criteria block
The clarity-check bonus score must remain neutral (6 points) when repointing from SC to AC, verified by measuring _clarity_score(fixture, 'epic') == 6 rather than assuming score equivalence
Remove '## success criteria' entry from _SCOPE_HEADINGS in assemble.py, leaving only '## acceptance criteria' to cover the collapsed vocabulary
A new contract test must demonstrate that an epic carrying '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Context' passes both clarity-check and check-ac gates with score 6
